[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31880725/c1ac45d151a4f230f43d3d774e9a7bbe9e8276b2.png[/img]

You can play the beta version by selecting 'beta' under the BETAS tab.

I think that this beta version could be a much more stable state than the original version due to various bugs fix and also the addition of the radial menu for quick selection. 

BUT there could be some bugs that I missed. Since including the joystick support may unintentionally create new bugs for those who are playing with keyboard and mouse. But currently, I have tested the whole game and no issues are found. 

Well if you found any, feel free to post in the discussion forum, thank you.

notes.title: TINT updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31880725/667b514d84f90eab5c61efadc8e4603031c70178.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

Since the game released on Jan 15th, I have updated the game every day. Here's the list of updates:

- New Health bar
- Objectives
- Improve pacing
- Improved character animations and cameras for cutscenes
- Added new events
- Fix glitches with falling through
- Fix objects collider
- Added volume control
- Fix missing languages
- Improve enemy hit collider range
- Improve gun gameplay
- Fix enemy falling through after being trapped
- Fix Leon trapped using Doll form
- Added new dialogues
- Fixed all grammar issues
- Increase camera sensitivity
- Improve character movements after sprint stopped.
- Improved environment models
- Added enemies to the desert area
-  Give more visual hints to the puzzle
- Make the monster boss easier to deal with
- Added 2 new achievements
- Fixed some human bugs
- Human bullets less damage
- Fix the lighting issue while playing in low/med setting
- Improved cutscenes

There could be more but forgotten.

notes.title: Interview & review by IGN SEA
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31880725/d20d95a0d2d904847601112d9b085ee85302fdff.jpg[/img]

I am very grateful for the opportunity to be interviewed and reviewed by IGN SEA! 

Here's a short extract from the article:
[i]As mentioned earlier, TINT is a game created by a solo developer. The game took roughly two to three years to develop.

In a recent interview with IGN Southeast Asia, Choo said creating a 3D game had always been his dream. The game’s story was inspired by different animes and fantasy movies. The main character, Leon, is a character that is heavily influenced by the anime series “Code Geass”. As for the villain in the game, he was created when he saw "a stranger wearing short shorts one day".

The developer also mentioned that he decided to develop TINT alone as it was tough to find someone with the same level of passion and drive as he did. In addition, financial constraints were also another hurdle he faced.[/i]

You can read the full article here 
https://sea.ign.com/there-is-no-tomorrow-pc/156995/feature/this-game-was-made-by-a-solo-sporean-developer-but-is-it-too-ambitious

notes.title: Release date & thoughts.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31880725/ccf4a0c05f4504d771228d4fc64d100bd092f44b.jpg[/img]

The game final release date is to be on December 3rd but there might be some delay to Jan 2020 due to publishing.

If there is no unpredictable changes, December 3rd is the day :)

The game has been in development for almost 3 years. The first 1 and the half year, I have been focusing on my energy on it while the rest of the time, I been working on smaller projects to get more experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31880725/64114e25b3a425c70e6b2675602e74b6573470f6.jpg[/img]

There Is No Tomorrow is a difficult game to make because I am a solo developer handling almost everything with the exception of the music which a few of them is composed by 'François Sivignon (Paranoid Cats)'.

Because of the scale of the game, I often have to delay the development until I feel confident again to approach it. In the end, I am proud of this project even though I am not sure how well it will do on Steam especially after the algorithmic changes that decreases the indie games' visibility.

So.. thank you all for following the game these years, It's been a long journey :)

[b]Hi everyone, the release date for 'There Is No Tomorrow' has been pushed back to 2019.[/b]

The game is finished but polishing and fixing the bugs will take a lot more time than I expected. The most time consuming part is the animated cutscenes.

The release date could be between March -April 2019. I will share more updates whenever I am ready.ːsteammockingː
